description: She wears an opaque rust-red floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Narrow cream-and-tan woven geometric borders frame the neckline, run down the bodice center and skirt opening, and circle the sleeve ends. A cream underdress shows through the lower front skirt opening. A brown leather belt has a large circular openwork metal buckle, small studs and a decorated hanging end. A cream wrap with narrow rust-brown patterned borders rests around her forearms and falls at either side. A brown closed-toe leather shoe is visible below the skirt. No visible headgear or weapon is present.
